OSM induces a mesenchymally enriched, cancer stem cell-like population in pancreatic cancer that promotes metastatic capacity and gemcitabine resistance.
OSM induces an EMT and CSC phenotype in pancreatic cancer, which can be reverted by ruxoliminib and by ZEB1 silencig.
oncostatin M induces an EMT and CSC phenotype in pancreatic cancer cells that are associated with increased metastasis and resistance to chemotherapy.
